title: git log --full-history is required to read a merge commit against its path
body: conflictingTickIDs parses the tick ids out of the integration branch's merge records for the files that conflict; plain `git log <sha> -- <paths>` prunes the merge commit (history simplification attributes the merged side's change to the side commit), and only --full-history shows it. Nothing in this repository documents that, and any future reader of 'which tick touched this file on the epic branch' will silently get the wrong answer. One line in a doc or a helper would pin it; I found it only because the resolve dispatch's inputs came back naming one tick instead of two.
